curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: pronounce words with the sounds /a:/,/æ/, / ɜː/, /ɑː/, /ə/, /b:/, /b/, /k/, /s/, /d/, /e/, /iː/, /f/ /g/, /h/ for oral fluency

interactions.prompt: Tap the word that begins with /b/.
Teacher says /k/ as in ___. Choose the word.
interactions.retryHint: Say cup slowly and listen to its first sound.

interactions.prompt: Which word begins with the long sound /iː/?
At the market, which word begins with /f/?
Choose the pair whose words begin with /d/ and /h/, in that order.
interactions.feedback: Well done! Drum begins /d/ and hat begins /h/.
interactions.retryHint: Say both first sounds before choosing.

interactions.prompt: Which sequence begins with /b/, /k/, /s/ in that order?
interactions.feedback: Sound star! You pronounced and matched all three sounds.
interactions.retryHint: Check one word at a time: /b/, then /k/, then /s/.
